mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workspace_ai_reminder (id, workspace_id, user_id, message, kind, hour, minute, once_date, weekdays, biweek_parity, anchor_monday, enabled, next_fire_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{workspaceId}, #{userId}, #{message}, #{kind}, #{hour}, #{minute}, #{onceDate}, #{weekdays}, #{biweekParity}, #{anchorMonday}, CAST(#{enabled} AS BOOLEAN), #{nextFireAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, workspace_id AS workspaceId, user_id AS userId, message, kind, hour, minute, once_date AS onceDate, weekdays, biweek_parity AS biweekParity, anchor_monday AS anchorMonday, enabled, next_fire_at AS nextFireAt FROM workspace_ai_reminder WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT id, workspace_id AS workspaceId, user_id AS userId, message, kind, hour, minute, once_date AS onceDate, weekdays, biweek_parity AS biweekParity, anchor_monday AS anchorMonday, enabled, next_fire_at AS nextFireAt FROM workspace_ai_reminder WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, workspace_id AS workspaceId, user_id AS userId, message, kind, hour, minute, once_date AS onceDate, weekdays, biweek_parity AS biweekParity, anchor_monday AS anchorMonday, enabled, next_fire_at AS nextFireAt FROM workspace_ai_reminder WHERE enabled = TRUE AND next_fire_at IS NOT NULL AND next_fire_at <= #{now} LIMIT 80
mapper.update: UPDATE workspace_ai_reminder SET next_fire_at = #{nextFireAt}, enabled = CAST(#{enabled} AS BOOLEAN) WHERE id = #{id} AND enabled = TRUE AND next_fire_at IS NOT NULL AND next_fire_at <= #{now}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workspace_ai_reminder_inbox (id, reminder_id, workspace_id, user_id, message, fired_at, dismissed) VALUES (#{id}, #{reminderId}, #{workspaceId}, #{userId}, #{message}, #{firedAt}, FALSE)
mapper.select: SELECT i.id, i.reminder_id AS reminderId, i.workspace_id AS workspaceId, w.name AS workspaceName, i.user_id AS userId, i.message, i.fired_at AS firedAt, i.dismissed FROM workspace_ai_reminder_inbox i LEFT JOIN sys_workspace w ON w.id = i.workspace_id WHERE i.user_id = #{userId} AND i.dismissed = FALSE ORDER BY i.fired_at DESC LIMIT 50
